limitations: NormalImpulseFiveSlotCandidateView is caller-constructed untrusted infrastructure, not a validator, result, certificate, attestation, producer, or proof.
The exact-five requirement creates only a candidate-view object; it is Runtime construction policy and does not establish Elliott structural validity or invalidity.
position_1 through position_5 are ordinal references to binding.ordered_children indexes zero through four and do not certify Waves 1 through 5.
The view retains one exact OrderedChildBinding but does not prove that its children belong to the parent or correspond to market structure.
Five logical candidate positions are not five validated waves and are not a visible-swing count; extensions may display more visible swings.
The protected package does not supply an executable normal-impulse 5-3-5-3-5 child-family requirement, so none is represented.
No child family, internal completion, required subdivision, pattern validity, structural validity, fatality, degree, timeframe, pivot, anchor, price, evidence, or ranking is established.
P004, P005, P006, P010 and every existing methodology behavior remain separate; constructing the view invokes none of them.
NormalImpulseFiveSlotCardinalityError is ordinary contract failure and has no methodology status, outcome, fatality, source, principle, or behavior metadata.
Only an exact OrderedChildBinding is accepted; detached IDs, strings, mappings, duck types, and binding subclasses are rejected.

Ordinary subclass routes are sealed, including multiple inheritance that suppresses cooperative subclass hooks, but hostile same-process custom metaclasses, type.__new__, reflection, monkeypatching, object.__new__, or object.__setattr__ are not a security boundary.
A hostile caller can fabricate or mutate an untrusted Python object in-process, but neither certifier accepts such an object and no certificate authority results.

A caller-controlled prefilled deepcopy memo or custom pickle dispatch can substitute or reconstruct untrusted objects; default copy/deepcopy and pickle behavior remain locked, and no reconstructed object gains authority.
JSON-compatible dataclass records are audit data only; explicitly reconstructed bindings and views are distinct untrusted identities.
Future methodology consumers must use exact-type checks and revalidate cardinality, binding identity, parent identity, all child identities, and tuple order at the point of use.
The existing structural-invalidity certificate is not subject-bound, and this baseline does not associate existing rule results with the five positions.
No validated-family producer exists, the family registry remains empty and sealed, and no family certificate can currently issue.
NORMAL-IMPULSE-FIVE-SLOT-CANDIDATE-VIEW-V1 is a writable development logical baseline and is not physically sealed.
